For purposes of these Authy App Terms, Any references to 'you' or 'your' refer to you as the user of the Authy App, and any references to 'Twilio' refer to Twilio Inc. ... Twilio owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Authy App."*
* Additionally, the website footer across `authy.com` states: *"Copyright © Twilio Inc. All rights reserved."*
